meta.promptText: Mujhe India mein 3000 rupees ke andar running shoes kharidne hain. Konse lene chahiye?

response.text:
Bharat mein 3,000 rupees ke budget mein running shoes ke liye kayi behtareen options available hain, jo achhi cushioning, durability aur grip dete hain.

Aapke budget ke hisaab se kuch best running shoes ki list neeche di gayi hai:

---

### Top Running Shoes Under ₹3,000 in India

| Brand & Model | Best For | Key Features | Estimated Price (INR) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Campus OXYFIT / FIRST** | Daily Jogging & Walking | Lightweight, breathable mesh upper, good flexibility | ₹1,200 - ₹1,800 |
| **Campus 360 / Active series** | Budget All-Rounder | Soft cushioning, daily wear durability | ₹1,500 - ₹2,200 |
| **Asian Ignite-01 / Wonder-13** | Value for Money | Super lightweight, sleek look, comfortable fit | ₹900 - ₹1,500 |
| **Sparx SM-621 / SX0423G** | Road Running | Sturdy build, high durability, strong grip on tarmac | ₹1,200 - ₹2,000 |
| **Red Tape Sports Shoes** | Casual & Light Running | Stylish design, comfortable memory foam insole | ₹1,500 - ₹2,500 (on sale) |
| **Puma Resolve / Anzarun Lite (Sale)** | Entry-level Branded | Premium look, dependable midsole cushioning, brand reliability | ₹2,200 - ₹3,000 (during Flipkart/Amazon sales) |

---

### Kuch Zaroori Tips Khareedne Se Pehle:

* **Agar aapka use regular road running ya jogging hai:** **Campus** ya **Sparx** ke shoes try karein, kyunki ye Indian roads par kafi durable sabit hote hain aur inka sole jaldi ghiste nahi hain.
* **Agar aapko branded (Puma/Nike/Adidas) chahiye:** Thoda wait karein ya online sales (jaise Flipkart Big Billion Days ya Amazon Great Indian Festival) ka use karein, jismein kayi baar 3,000 ke andar branded running shoes mil jaate hain.
* **Size ka dhyan rakhein:** Running shoes hamesha apne normal shoe size se **ek size bada** (ya 0.5 size bada) lein, kyunki daudte waqt pair thode phoolte hain aur aage ki taraf pressure padta hai.
